name: conventional_airport_express
description: The source describes a conventional mainline airport express without an eligible urban-rail mode.

candidates.title: Conventional airport express adds long-distance rolling stock
candidates.search_snippet: A conventional airport express added long-distance rolling stock.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic railway release. The conventional mainline airport express added long-distance rolling stock between the airport and an intercity terminal. No Metro, MRT, Subway, Light Rail, Tram, AGT, Monorail, People Mover, or Urban Rail mode is established.

contract_notes: Airport service purpose cannot transform a conventional mainline express into an eligible mode.
